scope_purpose: Evidence-bound certification of the standalone CUSTOSZV9.pyz software package and its CRFU behavior, with byte-exact preservation of the embedded CUSTOSZV8.pyz baseline. This is not certification or activation of the entire canonical Louksna system.
claims: The package ZIP structure, member limits, CRC integrity, source commit, size and SHA-256 are bound to an exact candidate.
The tracked 99,400-byte CUSTOSZV8.pyz baseline is embedded byte-for-byte and its SHA-256 is independently checked.
Two builds from the same source commit are byte-identical as recorded by producer evidence, then independently cross-checked by the trusted G22 evaluator.

The included CRFU offline self-test exercises bounded planning, resource fail-closed behavior, anti-paralysis, hash-linked journal tampering detection, offline checkpoint restoration, and a bounded event-driven SQLite queue.
An independent no-secret job executes the exact candidate's version, CRFU status, CRFU self-test, V8 self-test and V8 status commands; stdout/stderr hashes and return codes are recorded.
G23 evidence and the G24 decision are attested by separate GitHub Actions jobs using OIDC/Sigstore; both refer to the exact candidate commit and package digest.
Candidate Louksna.md and PUAC2.md files must remain byte-identical to the trusted default-branch copies.
exclusions: Certification of the complete canonical G01-G24 system scope.
Exact-byte comparison with LUNACORE_final_formalized_v25.md because that file is not present in the repository checkout.
Canonical admission or reclassification of PUAC.C25-C32, or transfer of Louksna.md authority.
Formal Agda/Cubical proof of model-implementation correspondence, HoTT or univalence.

Validation of theological dictionary correctness, hermeneutical correctness, training integrity of a model, or total coverage of canonical E01-E15/CFE001-CFE074 beyond exact baseline preservation and tested interfaces.
Production-host deployment, mTLS handshakes, remote-service operations, or host/production rollback tests.
Production activation, automatic promotion, external regulatory certification, or claims that the package is universally defect-free.
